en.title: Practise pegging a contour
en.intro: The A-frame is already calibrated. Keep one foot by the peg. Move the other until the string meets the level mark. Place a peg there and repeat.
en.aligned: The string is on the level mark. Place a peg here.
en.higher: The moving foot is higher than the foot by the peg.
en.lower: The moving foot is lower than the foot by the peg.
en.turn: Move the free foot up or down the slope
en.nextCue: Keep the foot at the new peg still. Swing the other foot past it.
en.complete: Contour marked. The ground at every peg is at the same height.
en.unavailable: Use the plumb-line gauge and controls to keep practising.
en.drag: Drag up or down on the slope.

zu.title: Zijwayeze ukubethela i-contour ngezikhonkwane
zu.intro: I-A-frame isihloliwe futhi inophawu lokulinganisa. Gcina umlenze owodwa eceleni kwesikhonkwane. Hambisa omunye kuze kube intambo ilenga phezu kophawu. Bethela isikhonkwane lapho, bese uphinda.
zu.aligned: Intambo ilenga phezu kophawu lokulinganisa. Bethela isikhonkwane lapha.
zu.higher: Umlenze owuhambisayo uphakeme kunalowo oseceleni kwesikhonkwane.
zu.lower: Umlenze owuhambisayo uphansi kunalowo oseceleni kwesikhonkwane.
zu.turn: Hambisa umlenze uye phezulu noma phansi emthambekeni
zu.nextCue: Gcina umlenze oseceleni kwesikhonkwane esisha unganyakazi. Jikisa omunye uwuyise ngale kwawo.
zu.complete: Usuyimakile i-contour. Umhlabathi usezingeni elifanayo kuzo zonke izikhonkwane.
zu.unavailable: Qhubeka uzilolonge usebenzisa inkomba yentambo nezinkinobho.
zu.drag: Hudula uye phezulu noma phansi emthambekeni.

st.title: Itlwaetse ho tshwaya contour ka dithupana
st.intro: A-frame e se e hlahlobilwe mme letshwao la ho lekalekana le se le beilwe. Boloka leoto le le leng pela thupana. Sutisa le leng ho fihlela kgwele e le hodima letshwao. Kenya thupana moo, o phete.
st.aligned: Kgwele e hodima letshwao la ho lekalekana. Kenya thupana mona.
st.higher: Leoto leo o le sutisang le hodimo ho leoto le pela thupana.
st.lower: Leoto leo o le sutisang le tlase ho leoto le pela thupana.
st.turn: Nyolosa kapa o theose leoto letswapong
st.nextCue: Boloka leoto le pela thupana e ntjha le sa sisinyehe. Potolosa le leng ho ya ka nqane ho lona.
st.complete: Contour e tshwailwe. Mobu o bophahamong bo le bong moo thupana ka nngwe e leng teng.
st.loading: Ema hanyane ha boikwetliso bo ntse bo bula…
st.unavailable: Tswela pele ho ikwetlisa ka sesupo sa kgwele le dikonopo.

ve.title: Nḓowenḓowe ya u swaya contour nga zwiṱanda
ve.intro: A-frame yo no ṱolwa, tshiswayo tsha vhuimo vhuthihi tsho no vhewa. Dzulani ni sa tshimbidzi mulenzhe u re tsini na tshiṱanda. Tshimbidzani muṅwe u swikela lutambo lu tshi fhaṱekea kha tshiswayo. Rwelani tshiṱanda henefho ni dovholole.
ve.aligned: Lutambo lu kha tshiswayo tsha vhuimo vhuthihi. Rwelani tshiṱanda hafha.
ve.higher: Mulenzhe une na khou u tshimbidza u nṱha ha mulenzhe u re tsini na tshiṱanda.
ve.lower: Mulenzhe une na khou u tshimbidza u fhasi ha mulenzhe u re tsini na tshiṱanda.
ve.turn: Tshimbidzani mulenzhe u gonye kana u tse fhethu ho sendamaho
ve.nextCue: Dzulani ni sa tshimbidzi mulenzhe u re tsini na tshiṱanda tshiswa. Monisani muṅwe mulenzhe u ye thungo iṅwe.
ve.complete: Contour yo swaywa. Mavu a kha vhuimo vhuthihi hune tshiṱanda tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha vha hone.
ve.unavailable: Bvelani phanḓa na nḓowenḓowe ni tshi shumisa tshisumbi tsha lutambo na dzigunubu.
ve.drag: Kokodzani ni tshi ya nṱha kana fhasi fhethu ho sendamaho.

ts.title: Titolovete ku funga contour hi swikhomelo
ts.intro: A-frame yi se yi kamberiwile naswona mfungho wa ku ringanana wu se wu vekiwe. Hlayisa nenge wun'we etlhelweni ka xikhomelo. Rhurhisa lowun'wana ku kondza ntambhu yi fika eka mfungho. Nghenisa xikhomelo kwalaho kutani u tlhela u endla tano.
ts.aligned: Ntambhu yi le ka mfungho wa ku ringanana. Nghenisa xikhomelo laha.
ts.higher: Nenge lowu u wu rhurhisaka wu le henhla ka nenge lowu nga etlhelweni ka xikhomelo.
ts.lower: Nenge lowu u wu rhurhisaka wu le hansi ka nenge lowu nga etlhelweni ka xikhomelo.
ts.scene: Ndhawu yo rhelela yo titoloveta eka yona
ts.turn: Rhurhisa nenge wu ya ehenhla kumbe ehansi endhawini yo rhelela
ts.nextCue: Hlayisa nenge lowu nga etlhelweni ka xikhomelo lexintshwa wu nga fambi. Rhendzelekisa lowun'wana wu ya etlhelweni lerin'wana.
ts.complete: Contour yi funghiwe. Misava yi le ka mpimo wun'we wa ku tlakuka laha xikhomelo xin'wana ni xin'wana xi nga kona.
ts.unavailable: Yana mahlweni u titoloveta hi xikombiso xa ntambhu ni tikunupu.
ts.drag: Koka u ya ehenhla kumbe ehansi endhawini yo rhelela.
